verdict.rationale: Sardine documents a rule engine and a no-code rule editor, and it claims credit models can be built, tested, and deployed. None of the evidence mentions version history, change review or approval, or rollback for rules or automations. Rule authoring and testing are adjacent features, not versioning or rollback, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
